arguments.query: select event_id,booking_id,status,attempts,substr(payload,1,150) p from outbox where status!="delivered"
select c.charge_id,c.booking_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state,c.amount_cents,b.status bs from charges c left join bookings b using(booking_id) where b.status!="confirmed" or b.booking_id is null

select "fh" k,flight_id a,cast(fare_cents as text) b,"" c from fare_holds union all select "fl",flight_id,cast(fare_cents as text),cast(version as text) from flights union all select "cache",key,value,"" from cache
select name,sql from sqlite_master where name in ("flights","fare_holds","cache")
select "fh" k,flight_id a,price_cents b,until_step c from fare_holds union all select "fl",flight_id,price_cents,version from flights union all select "cache",key,value,"" from cache

select (select count(*) from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from checkins c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) nocheckin,(select count(*) from outbox where status="pending") pend,(select count(*) from bookings where status="pending") pb,(select count(*) from refunds) ref
select service,path,status,message,count(*) n from (select * from request_logs order by rowid desc limit 60) group by 1,2,3,4

select b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and c.state="captured") cap,(select group_concat(status) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id) ob,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) ck, count(*) n from bookings b group by 1,2,3,4,5,6,7
select rowid,service,path,status,duration_ms,message from request_logs where status>=400 and message not like "%sold out%" order by rowid desc limit 12

select (select max(rowid) from request_logs) mx,(select group_concat(key||"="||value," | ") from cache) cache,(select group_concat(flight_id||":"||price_cents||"v"||version) from flights) fl,(select count(*) from customer_events) ce
